notes: Delete of replace-0005's rule. The new members named in the prompt go only through the rule: determinate 'does not know'. Unlike the replace, the delete leaves consistent worlds: forgetting a rule contradicts nothing, so a model may keep a well-known member's value stored by name (or worked out without the rule) while the rule itself is gone, as in any TBox delete (README, Delete under determinacy). The equilateral triangle's 60 degrees and the right triangle's complementary acute angles are each stored by name or reached through the rule; the choices are independent, so there are 4 worlds. Keeping either value does not re-derive the general rule (it covers one kind of triangle only).
